skillAssessment.clarity: Good - SKILL.md is well-written with clear descriptions of capabilities, auth, and market rules
skillAssessment.accuracy: Poor - references 10 scripts that DO NOT EXIST in the repository
skillAssessment.completeness: The skill describes the full trade cycle but provides zero working implementation
skillAssessment.executability: Failed - an agent following SKILL.md literally would fail at every step since no scripts exist
skillAssessment.workaround: The @baozi.bet/mcp-server npm package (76 tools) provides all the described functionality as importable JavaScript modules, making it possible to complete all milestones
skillAssessment.verdict: The SKILL.md is vaporware documentation. The described scripts were never built. The actual working tooling is the MCP server package, which works well but is a completely different interface than what SKILL.md describes. A naive agent would be completely stuck.

methodUsed: Imported functions directly from @baozi.bet/mcp-server npm package (v5.0.0) which provides the same capabilities described in SKILL.md but as JavaScript module exports, not CLI scripts. Built custom .mjs scripts to call listMarkets(), fetchAndBuildBetTransaction(), getPositionsEnriched(), then signed and submitted transactions using @solana/web3.js.
betMarket: Will the SEC approve a prediction market ETF before Jun 30, 2026?
keyFindings: SKILL.md is vaporware - describes 10 scripts that don't exist in the repo
The repo is a bounty/integration platform, not a working skill with executable scripts
The real working tooling is @baozi.bet/mcp-server npm package (76 tools)
Baozi API (baozi.bet/api/markets) returns 401 - their internal RPC key appears expired
Direct Solana RPC reads work fine for market data
Pari-mutuel markets have no pre-resolution exit - confirmed by code audit
Only 3 out of 15 active markets are still open for betting (most have passed closing time)
All open markets are Lab layer (community-created), no Official markets open
Very low liquidity - largest open market pool is 0.03 SOL
blockers: Primary: SKILL.md scripts don't exist - requires finding and using alternative tooling
Secondary: Baozi API backend broken (401 on all endpoints) - must read directly from chain
Tertiary: Very few open markets with minimal liquidity
